messages:
alexa: Quick heads-up — starting onboarding for model 'ion-20b' in staging. Need a minimal prompt/chat template + tool-call schema that plays nice with our structured-output evals. Also posting initial quant runs below.

mauro: @alexa can you attach the model ref and which repo/commit produced the checkpoint? also which tokenizer? :eyes:

alexa: model ref: gs://models/ion/ion-20b/v1.2. tokenizer = llama-tokenizer v0.3. checkpoint built from pr/472. planning int8 and int4 runs.

jia: Quick onboarding checklist (for this thread):
- sanity run: 1000 prompts from core-eval set
- quant sweep: fp16, int8, q4_0, q4_1
- metrics: exact-match, chrF, perplexity, latency P50/P95, memory 
- tool-call smoke: search+invoke shape + failure cases
- structured-output: JSON schema conformance on 200 examples
- gating: block if exact-match drops >3% vs fp16 baseline or if hallucination rate +5%

sam: sharing first quant numbers from local rig (quick, noisy):
- fp16 baseline: latency P50 180ms, P95 310ms, perf_score 1.00
- int8-run (per-channel): P50 135ms, P95 260ms, perf_score 0.98 (-2%)
- q4_0: P50 95ms, P95 220ms, perf_score 0.92 (-8%)
- q4_1: P50 105ms, P95 230ms, perf_score 0.94 (-6%)
Notes: perf_score = weighted quality aggregate (higher is better). These were with batch=1, seq=512.

priya: thanks Sam. can we see failure modes? any structured-output examples that break in q4_0?

sam: yes, attaching a couple of samples inline:
```
Prompt: "Find phone numbers for Acme Corp in the doc."
FP16: {"phone": "+1-555-1234", "confidence": 0.96}
q4_0: {"phone": "555-1234 or 555-5678", "confidence": 0.51}  <-- extra hallucinated candidate, lower confidence
```

mauro: that matches what we saw in earlier quant runs — list-synthesis tasks degrade earlier. For tool-calling we should be strict about the schema and prefer deterministic wrappers.

alexa: Proposed chat template for API integration (please copy to onboarding doc if ok):
```
USER: {{user_instructions}}
ASSISTANT: {
  "type": "response",
  "result": {
    "text": "<natural language reply>",
    "tools": [
      {"name":"search","args":{"q":"<query>"}}
    ],
    "structured": {"items": [...] }
  }
}
```
Goal: assistant should emit a top-level JSON object when tool_call is expected. Keep free-text under result.text for fallback.

jia: For SDK usage, suggest enforcing `response_format=json_schema` header and validating at the server side. Example curl we tested: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.run/v1/chat/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"ion-20b","input":"<prompt>","response_format":{"type":"json_schema","schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"phone":{"type":"string"}}}}}'
```
If validation fails, return 422 and a structured error with `validation_errors` so the app can fallback to plain text parsing.

priya: For the eval gating, can we add a regression-level metric for tool-call fidelity? e.g., for search: compare returned ids to oracle set, fail if F1 drops >5%

mauro: yes. also add per-route rollout policy: start 5% traffic on dedicated-staging with fallback to fp16 hosted. If regressions detected auto-rollback.

alexa: Action items:
- @sam run the full 1k core-eval sweep for fp16 + int8 + q4_1 by EOD tomorrow. add detailed logs to run link: https://runs.redwood.local/runs/ion-20b/123
- @jia add the chat template and schema to onboarding checklist in the repo (docs/onboarding/ion-20b.md)
- @priya define tool-call fidelity tests and thresholds, add them to eval harness
- @mauro set rollout policy and canary config in experiments console

ops-bot: deploy_job started for staging-cluster-7 (job id: dj-7782). Logs: https://ops.redwood.local/logs/dj-7782

sam: acked, starting runs now. will post summary and failure samples here. :white_check_mark:

priya: thanks — will prep a quick dashboard for tool-call diffs so PMs can eyeball quality.

mauro: moving checklist items into the intake doc now. ping if you need infra tweaks.

alexa: great team — we'll regroup after the sweep. if anyone sees >5% regression ping #eng-oncall and block rollout.
